observations: Front photograph confirms paired low ribbed cupolas, main glazed dome and lantern, curved foyers, central arch and floral frieze.
Perspective establishes visible forms, not measured bay sizes or roof pitches.

limitations: The source plan is an exhibit-installation diagram. No complete as-built structural/elevation set was inspected.
Text extreme width250 ft conflicts with the deeper projecting diagram envelope. The76 m end body and88 m full projection are separate authored decisions.
Rear/end roof profiles, gallery openings, foyer-to-dome joints and concealed service layout are incomplete evidence; no exact as-built reconstruction claimed.
Cream staff has period text support; exact glass/frame/roof/foliage colours, fine sculpture and planting layout are art choices.
Rumsey Cram text record required Verify Access; it was not bypassed or used as measurement evidence. Other unseen rear-elevation leads are unverified.
Historical construction and simulation materials remain unassigned.
